hypotheses.name: Capacity or resource bottleneck
hypotheses.next_check: Inspect resource utilization and queue ownership during the affected interval.

hypotheses.name: Upstream dependency degradation
hypotheses.next_check: Correlate upstream request IDs, provider status and downstream failures.

hypotheses.name: Configuration or operating-mode change
hypotheses.next_check: Compare configuration and operating mode before and after the change.

hypotheses.name: Physical subsystem issue
hypotheses.next_check: Obtain device diagnostic codes or a qualified inspection; telemetry alone may not locate a damaged component.

hypotheses.name: Measurement or data-quality issue
hypotheses.next_check: Verify timestamps, units, collection health and the original measurement source.
